# Quickstart

A step forward to play the classic adventure of Kathana!\
Here you will find the guides from installing the game up to mastering the basics.

If you have technical difficulties and other concerns, for quick support please contact GameOlic Staff at our discord server.

# Installing the game

Kathana is available on Steam,  if you already have a steam account, you can download and install the game through this link:

{% embed url="<https://store.steampowered.com/app/2081880/Kathana/>" %}


# Game Settings

There are 2 types of settings that the game uses.

First is from the KathanaLauncher.exe (The Launcher) and the second is in game.

### Launcher Settings

First, we will setup the game resolution.\
Open the launcher (KathanaLauncher.exe) via steam and click on "Settings".\
In the settings you will see the following:\
![](https://2359489951-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F3ZihNq2k3QooIZjlllqD%2Fuploads%2F9dgN5Pu5x4o3bdfbiGiU%2F%7B2452B2CF-F98D-4C44-A135-9CDF25DBB922%7D.png?alt=media\&token=cc552eb7-333a-434a-a78e-9bec29af293d)

Resolution is the setting for the game's window size\
Quality is the setting for the graphics quality\
Sound is the setting to set it as stereo or 5.1 & more\
Shadows can be set as realtime as well\
Window mode when checked runs the game in window mode, unchecking it will make the game run in full screen mode\
HD Texture is experimental and unstable but its a nice touch if you have high-end graphics card

### Game Settings

<figure><img src="https://2359489951-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F3ZihNq2k3QooIZjlllqD%2Fuploads%2FVXp9KvhoGTsyMWjvRO2j%2F%7BA67AC8CA-C198-4C5A-B46A-0572F7ADFD32%7D.png?alt=media&amp;token=2ecc30af-d77e-48a9-b00a-e18291a382dd" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

UI Gamma sets the transparency of all game widgets (game windows)\
Show name hides the player's name\
Effects shows or hides game effects\
Simplify vend turns the "Player vendors" into a chest, good for optimisation\
Sound Effects sets the volume of the environmental sfx as well as the skills and other ambient sounds\
Music sets the volume for the game's background music

Here you will learn where to level / grind at your current character level.\
This guide will be in basic format and leaves room for you to explore in game!

| Player Level | Grind Spots                                                           | Tips                                                                                                                |
| ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1 \~ 10      | Mandara, Vasabhum Caura                                               | Also do the basic quests for additional Prana                                                                       |
| 11-15        | Mandara, Vasabhum Kulapra, Mlecchas Caura                             |                                                                                                                     |
| 16-20        | Mandara, Aprah Varaha Raja -> Mara Land                               |                                                                                                                     |
| 21-30        | Shambala, Ulkamulka, Ulkamulka Caura & Ulkamulka Satvan               | Stay here as long as you want while waiting for Ananga Invasion Event                                               |
| 31-45        | Ananga, Ananga Dvanta, Kaulitara, Tarantula                           | Shambala, You have options here, either go Ananga until 40 then proceed to Kaulitara or just stay in Ananga Dvantas |
| 46-50        | <p>Shambala Dungeon or Jina<br>Zarku, Zarku Gosu, Zaku, Zaku Gosu</p> | This spots are good for melees                                                                                      |

# Movement & Camera

The game uses click-to-move with combination of WASD as a support.

Players can use both movement according to their liking.

Using WASD gives more freedom of character movement as it allows you to strafe.

### Movement Controls

* <kbd>W</kbd>  - move forward
* <kbd>S</kbd> - move backward
* <kbd>A</kbd> / <kbd>D</kbd> - move side ways
* <kbd>A</kbd>+<kbd>W</kbd> / <kbd>D</kbd>+<kbd>W</kbd>- move diagonally forward
* <kbd>A</kbd>+<kbd>S</kbd> / <kbd>D</kbd>+<kbd>S</kbd> - move diagonally backward

### Camera Controls

* <kbd>⬅️</kbd> - rotate camera to the left
* <kbd>➡️</kbd> - rotate camera to the right
* <kbd>F11</kbd> - follow skill projectiles
* <kbd>F12</kbd>  - Free Cam Mode / Static Camera Mode
* Right Mouse Button + Drag - rotates camera omnidirectional


# Tribes & Jobs

In Kathana there are 8 Tribes and 8 Jobs.

* Naga & Kimnara
  * These two are the off tanks and main tanks of the game.
  * Can switch job to Banar (off tank, berserker) or Satya (The full tank)
  * Uses variety of weapons but spears are recommended
  * <mark style="color:red;">Chakra Recommendation: Heart + Muscle or All-Heart for Full Tank</mark>
* Asura & Rakshasa
  * The assassins in game, fast & agile
  * Can wield bows, daggers & swords
  * Specializes in fast and stealth kills
  * Jobs: Druka (dual wielder) or Karya (Archer)
  * <mark style="color:red;">Chakra Recommendation: Heart + Muscle (Melee) or Heart + Nerve (Bow)</mark>
* Deva & Garuda
  * These are the main mage archetypes, they can cast fire spells, ice spells and lightning spells
  * Slow but pack a punch!
  * Master of AOE (area of effect) skills
  * Jobs: Abikara (Elementalist) or Samabat (Summoner)
  * <mark style="color:red;">Chakra Recommendation: Heart + Mental or All-Mental build</mark>
* Yaksa & Gandharva
  * These are the support tribes, they excel in giving buffs or de-buffs to friends & foes alike
  * Able to use ressurection skills
  * Has a lot of buff skills
  * Jobs: Nakayuda (Off-tank support) or Vidya (Priest, full support)
  * <mark style="color:red;">Chakra Recommendation: Muscle+ Heart + Nerve / Muscle + Heart or All-Heart build for support</mark>

# Status Effects & Chakra

In Kathana, the character's growth depends on how the player distributes its Chakra.<br>

### Chakras

* Muscle - Gives physical damage and slight increase to Defense
* Nerve - Gives accuracy, critical hit rate, evasion and increase damages to Bows
* Mental - Gives magical resistances and increases Tapas points & damage to staff or canes
* Heart - Gives your character hit points (hp)

#### Limitations:

As of August 8, 2025 Update Deva & Garuda can maximize their Nerve Chakra from 350 to 600. While all Classes can maximize their Heart Chakra from 400 to 800.

### Status ailments

* Stun - your character enters a stun state, unable to move
* Sleep - your character are forced into sleep state, can disrupted when hit by any form of attacks
* Slow - reduces your movement speed for a duration
* Bleed - DoT (Damage over time) that reduces your Hit points per seconds
* Poisoned - DoT (Damage over time) reduces your Hit points over time but can be cured
* Burning - DoT (Damage over time) reduces your Hit points over time when hit by flame spells
* Electrocuted - DoT (Damage over time) reduces your Hit points over time when hit by Lightning type spells
* Frost Bite - DoT (Damage over time) reduces your Hit points over time when hit by Ice type spells


# What is Taney?

Taney is the secondary premium currency that is used solely to purchase items from the premium shop.

{% content-ref url="/pages/9S8eEES6ZUZibxCQLdbN" %}
[How to buy Taney?](/wiki/what-is-taney/how-to-buy-taney)
{% endcontent-ref %}

Taney is Kathana's premium currency that opens doors to:

* **Powerful consumables** to aid you in challenging quests,
* **Premium services** for advanced gameplay features,
* **Character appearance changes** to customize your divine avatar,
* **Exclusive items** and conveniences to enhance your adventure,

*Your Taney purchases directly support Kathana's continued development during Early Access, helping us craft an even more immersive mythological experience!* **Purchasing Taney Through Steam** With Kathana's Early Access launch on Steam, all Taney purchases are seamlessly integrated through Steam's secure marketplace. This ensures safe, reliable transactions while supporting our ongoing development efforts. We recommend enabling Steam Overlay for the smoothest experience. The entire process is designed to get you back into the action as quickly as possible!&#x20;

**Understanding Our Pricing** we’re committed to keeping the game’s economy fair and enjoyable for all players. Due to Steam’s 30% transaction fee, we’ve carefully adjusted Taney packs amounts and pricing to preserve fair value and keep Kathana’s in-game economy healthy, ensuring balance without impacting your overall gameplay experience.

### Premium Shop

<figure><img src="https://2359489951-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F3ZihNq2k3QooIZjlllqD%2Fuploads%2F1AXZbpTKWoGh2fjWmfuN%2F%7B89C7125A-AEA0-463C-9BF9-E87043EA759E%7D.png?alt=media&amp;token=e140c83d-0112-447f-a97c-73d523dd0122" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>


# How to buy Taney?

Purchasing Taney is only available on Kathana's Steam page

As you embark on your mythological journey through our Hindu-inspired MMORPG, Taney serves as your gateway to enhanced experiences, powerful consumables, premium services, and stunning character transformations.

This comprehensive guide will walk you through everything you need to know about purchasing Taney safely and efficiently. We'll also cover what to do if your Taney doesn't appear immediately in your account, ensuring you can resolve any issues quickly and get back to your adventure.

{% stepper %}
{% step %}
Open the **Premium Services Window**

By clicking the Premium Item button located in the bottom right of the game

<figure><img src="https://2359489951-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F3ZihNq2k3QooIZjlllqD%2Fuploads%2Flm980iPFK4L7fhfzYwUt%2F%7B7EF76F47-A0C6-43E1-B5E8-2FC412C959C1%7D.png?alt=media&amp;token=6d6dcf34-0eca-4dbd-844d-45c3615b8243" alt=""><figcaption><p>Premium item button </p></figcaption></figure>
{% endstep %}

{% step %}
**Select: Recharge Taney** from the menu

<figure><img src="https://2359489951-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F3ZihNq2k3QooIZjlllqD%2Fuploads%2FwdoePcLnBSOPcdqGjBX5%2F%7B49F06588-9916-470F-AEFD-E409CAD11E51%7D.png?alt=media&amp;token=4a23f9b2-8b01-4f06-884d-6048d51a9697" alt=""><figcaption><p>This opens the steam overlay browser</p></figcaption></figure>

# Taney Delivery Expectations

### **Instant Delivery (Most Common)**&#x20;

In the vast majority of cases, your Taney will appear in your account immediately after purchase completion. No waiting, no delays—just instant access to enhance your divine journey!&#x20;

**Occasional Processing Time**&#x20;

Sometimes Steam needs a moment to process transactions, especially for:

* First-time purchases on your account,
* New payment methods,
* Routine security verifications,

This is completely normal and shows Steam's commitment to secure transactions.

<figure><img src="https://2359489951-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F3ZihNq2k3QooIZjlllqD%2Fuploads%2FdfuSr8fKhooBlz0kbKuX%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=7347c6e0-02a6-4088-9812-c4804bebc446" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

## Didn’t Get Your Taney? Here’s What to Do,

Don't worry! Here's your action plan:&#x20;

**First Response (30-Minute Rule)**

* **Wait 30 minutes** and check your Taney balance again,
* Steam's verification process occasionally needs this time buffer,

#### **If Issues Persist - Gather Your Evidence:**

1. Open Steam (application or web browser),
2. Click the dropdown arrow next to your username (top-right corner),
3. Select **Account Details**,
4. Navigate to **View Purchase History**,
5. Find your Taney purchase and click for details,
6. Copy the **Transaction ID** - this is your ticket to resolution!

<figure><img src="https://2359489951-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F3ZihNq2k3QooIZjlllqD%2Fuploads%2FNXyeN3s9ZfpYDWdp18pe%2Fimage.png?alt=media&amp;token=c3eebc52-c291-4d12-a8c3-fa4625344c98" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

#### **Contact Our Support Team**&#x20;

Head to our [official Discord support channel](https://discord.com/channels/1363839027114934315/1363859739431276655) and create a support ticket including:

* Your copied **Transaction ID**,
* **Any character name** from your Kathana account,

Our dedicated support team will resolve your issue quickly and get you back to your mythological adventures!

## Important Reminders,

**Steam Security First**

* Steam handles all payment processing and confirmation.,
* We never have access to your billing information. Steam keeps your information secure.,
* "Pending" or "Under Review" transactions are Steam's way of ensuring secure purchases.,

**Automatic Integration**&#x20;

Once Steam gives the green light on your transaction, our servers automatically credit your Taney—no manual intervention needed!&#x20;

**Dedicated Support** If you've followed all troubleshooting steps and still need assistance, our support team is standing by to ensure you get exactly what you purchased, when you need it.&#x20;

{% hint style="warning" %}
*Ready to enhance your divine adventure? Your Taney purchase not only enriches your gameplay but helps us continue developing the rich, mythological world of Kathana. Thank you for supporting our Early Access journey!*&#x20;
{% endhint %}

***Happy Gaming, Pathfinders!***

# PvP System

Kathana as variety of PvP System ranging from 1v1 duel to group pvp in specialized maps.

### Player Kill

Players can engage in PK (player kill) when reaching level 30. You can toggle the PK switch to ON or OFF from the shortcut menu.

<figure><img src="https://2359489951-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F3ZihNq2k3QooIZjlllqD%2Fuploads%2FbfrdbEucitYmWmEpM6Eo%2F%7B2830E8B1-C11B-49CE-9920-1AD034B193E6%7D.png?alt=media&amp;token=d2032c9e-622e-40a2-b6cc-31a569af47b3" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

### Duels

Duel is another form of single combat against another player with their consent.\
You simply invite him to duel and wait for the response.\
To initiate a duel, simply right click on the duel icon from the command window (C) or drag the duel icon into your skill hot bars then target it to your desired opponent.

<figure><img src="https://2359489951-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F3ZihNq2k3QooIZjlllqD%2Fuploads%2FQe89e8vbfdryquWIJeNT%2F%7B5C891DE7-7203-43CF-A8A9-EB034F2748BE%7D.png?alt=media&amp;token=da9a4e4b-9efc-4ffc-bc01-3e4678e01ed3" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

### Anaka Kruma

Anaka Kruma is the first map for level 20 to level 59 to engage in a group pvp. There is no objective in this map, its just kill or be killed!\
Also this map has high drop rate of Rupiah and your rupiah can also be dropped when you get killed by opposing force.

<figure><img src="https://2359489951-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F3ZihNq2k3QooIZjlllqD%2Fuploads%2F9S6EZAL4qVD0VXAiHwFg%2FAnaka.png?alt=media&amp;token=bd52a553-b297-4eb5-b437-d35437fc4203" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

### Kruma

An all out war map between 3 factions!\
The objective is to collect Kala Cores from your enemy's base and bring it to your base (sort of like Capture the Flag).\
The first faction to collect 5 Kala Cores will be able to open the gates to Chaturanga!

<figure><img src="https://2359489951-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F3ZihNq2k3QooIZjlllqD%2Fuploads%2FxMrkdZ7gcX3CZjJyOXID%2FHigh_Kruma.png?alt=media&amp;token=31daa95d-51ca-4bf0-9ba5-641e77b5c619" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

### Chaturanga

This map has very high Rupiah drop rate and each room will have mini-bosses.\
Each mini-bosses drops "chess pieces" that will turn into "key" to open the final boss room.\
The final boss "Raphu" will drop Crystal in which will be used as a catalyst to make your Crystal Weapons!

<figure><img src="https://2359489951-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F3ZihNq2k3QooIZjlllqD%2Fuploads%2FEDpXheIUdnOPTLglFcWY%2FChaturanga.png?alt=media&amp;token=146431a8-bbbe-4cac-85ad-0e0d15bec20b" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

### Fortress Arena

This is the place where you battle with another guild!\
The first to conquer a fortress will have to defend the fort within the allocated time!\
Guilds who owns a fort after the Event will be granted a Rupiah reward and as well as an exclusive Dungeon for their guild members only!

<figure><img src="https://2359489951-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F3ZihNq2k3QooIZjlllqD%2Fuploads%2FAeK8w442r7v9asyuzQe6%2FFortressWar.png?alt=media&amp;token=0f7a45df-1224-438d-96cf-2af7cec9a236" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

### Biryu Castle Siege

This is one of the major pvp event in Kathana where a guild can control the taxes for the vendors!

<figure><img src="https://2359489951-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F3ZihNq2k3QooIZjlllqD%2Fuploads%2F7kXmW3kmyFZqoWcss5fd%2FBiryu.png?alt=media&amp;token=3d02694e-4a49-4301-8123-514ff5734084" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>


# Kruma Mechanics

Kruma is just like a Capture the Flag game mode

{% stepper %}
{% step %}

### Select the god you will follow

In order to enter Kruma (or Anaka Kruma) you need to have a "God" followed. There are 3 Gods, Shiva (blue), Brahma (yellow) & Vishnu (red).\
These gods are the 3 main factions of Kathana.\
\
You can select a god when you reach level  20 and visiting Priest Vananta in Mandara.
{% endstep %}

{% step %}

### Ways to enter Kruma

There are 3 ways to enter Kruma

* By using Ziva Pustika (or Quality Ziva Pustika)
* By using the portal near Horseman Rahul in Mandara
  {% endstep %}

{% step %}

### What to do when in Kruma?

As said earlier, Kruma works like Capture the flag game mode, every "god" has "3" Kala Cores.\
First to collect 5 Kala Cores for their faction will open the gate to Chaturanga

Slaying players in Kruma will also give you Master Points.\
Master Points are ranked globally (entire server) and highest rank gets special skills called "God Skills".
{% endstep %}

{% step %}

### Collecting Kala Cores

We mentioned that each faction has 3 Kala Cores, and first to collect 5 will open the gate to Chaturanga.\
To get these Kala Cores, you must invade the opposing faction's base and obtain the Kala Core then bring it back to your Base.\
Placing the Enemy Kala Core in your base counts as a score and a system notice will be shown in the system chat.

The system chat will show the current score between the 3 factions.

{% hint style="info" %}
You cannot use teleport items such as pustika while you are carrying the Kala Core.

<mark style="color:orange;">**Kala Core drops when you die.**</mark>
{% endhint %}
{% endstep %}
{% endstepper %}


# Caste System

Welcome to the competitive world of caste rankings! Whether you're a newcomer or a veteran looking to understand the new system, this guide will walk you through everything you need to know about climbing the ranks and earning those coveted God Skill Points. Before the October 15 update, ranking up was a leisurely journey. You could take your time gathering Master Points (MP) at your own pace, eventually reaching the highest ranks with a maximum of 7 God Skill Points. While relaxed, this system had some drawbacks:

* No competitive edge or sense of urgency,
* Progress tied to other players' activity,
* Everyone could reach the same peak, reducing that special feeling of achievement,
* Limited God Skill Points,
* Missing ranks and competitive tiers,
* Inactive players could camp at the top indefinitely,

The new competitive system changes all that! Now, active participation in PvP activities is essential for strengthening your character. This system rewards your participation and helps you stand out not only in Faction PvP Zones but also in Player Killing areas, Castle Sieges, Fortress Durga, and Guild Wars.

### How the Competitive System Works,

The new ranking system rewards dedication and consistent PvP engagement. Once you reach higher ranks, you'll need to actively participate in PvP zones to maintain your position and prevent rank decay. It's all about staying active and competitive!

#### The Caste Ranks (From Lowest to Highest),

* **Sudra** 3 → 2 → 1,
* **Vaishya** 3 → 2 → 1,
* **Ksatriya** 3 → 2 → 1,
* **Braman** 3 → 2 → 1,
* **Avatara** 3 → 2 → 1,
* **Mijung** 3 → 2 → 1,

Starting at **Ksatriya 3**, you'll earn your first God Skill Point! From there, each rank you climb grants you an additional point, up to a maximum of **12 God Skill Points**. These points unlock passive God Skills that you can activate in your skill window (press K) to customize your character's abilities.

### Understanding Your Rank,

Your caste rank depends on two important factors:

1. Your accumulated Master Points (MP),
2. Your position in the overall rankings,

#### Master Points: Your Path to Power,

From **Sudra 3** through **Ksatriya 1**, ranking up is straightforward. Just accumulate the required Master Points. There's no competition yet, so you can focus on gathering MP at your own pace. However, once you hit **Braman 3**, you'll enter the **Top 100 players** bracket, where your rank is determined by both your Master Points AND your position relative to other top players.

#### The Top 100 Competition,

To break into the Top 100, you need at least **60,001 Master Points** to reach Braman 3. But here's the catch: only **25 players** can hold the Braman 3 rank at any given time across all three factions. Here's how it works: Let's say you've just hit 60,001 MP. If all 25 Braman 3 spots are filled by players with higher MP totals than yours, you'll stay at Ksatriya 1 until you can overtake the lowest-ranked Braman 3 player. Once your MP exceeds theirs, you'll swap positions—you'll rise to Braman 3, and they'll drop back to Ksatriya 1. **Key points to remember:**

* Hitting the minimum MP requirement doesn't guarantee an automatic promotion,
* You must compete for limited spots in each rank,
* You'll only rank up when your points exceed the lowest player in the rank above you,

This competitive structure applies to all ranks from **Braman 3** up to **Mijung 1**, with the ultimate Mijung 1 rank limited to just **one player across all God factions!**

### Rank Requirements and Rewards,

Here's the complete breakdown of Master Points needed, available spots, and God Skill Points for each rank:

> **Tip:** You can type `$caste` to summon this table anytime, anywhere in our Discord server!

{% content-ref url="/pages/MuKNzyNbShoS574856CJ" %}
[Caste Ranking](/wiki/pvp-system/caste-system/caste-ranking)
{% endcontent-ref %}

Altogether, these spots make up a total of 100 top-ranked players! **Example Scenario** Imagine you're currently Avatara 1 and approaching the minimum MP requirement for Mijung 3 (260,001 MP). However, both Mijung 3 spots are already occupied by players with 270,000 MP and 290,000 MP respectively. Simply reaching 260,001 MP won't be enough to rank up. You'll need to surpass the lowest Mijung 3 player's total, in this case, 270,000 MP. Once you hit **270,001 MP**, you'll claim that player's spot and ascend to Mijung 3, while they'll drop down to Avatara 1.

### Tips for Success,

The Competitive Ranking System rewards dedication, strategy, and consistent PvP participation. Here's what you need to know: **For Early Ranks (Sudra → Ksatriya):**

* Focus on accumulating Master Points at your own pace,
* No competition yet. Just gather the required MP to advance,
* Start earning God Skill Points from Ksatriya 3 onward,

**For High Ranks (Braman → Mijung):**

* Limited spots mean fierce competition—be ready to fight for your place,
* Your ranking position matters just as much as your total MP,
* Surpassing other top players is essential for advancement,
* Stay active to maintain your rank and prevent decay,

**General Strategy:**

* Participate regularly in all PvP activities to earn Master Points,
* Once the leaderboards are released, keep an eye on them to track your competition,
* Each rank from Ksatriya 3 onward grants powerful God Skill Points,
* Customize your character with passive God Skills to gain an edge in battle

# Auto Hunting System

A Kathana exclusive feature that allows our players to do auto-hunt.

{% hint style="info" %} <mark style="color:$warning;">**This feature is heavily under-development.**</mark>\
This feature allows our players to auto hunt while working/or multi-tasking.\
Instead of downloading 3rd party apps from dubious websites or paying a tool to do the same, we are adding this for the safety of our players.
{% endhint %}

<details>

<summary>Level 45 - The 2nd Job</summary>

{% hint style="info" %}
Advancing into the 2nd class needs you to run three quests from Zangzu in Jina Town: Test of Wisdom, Test of Justice, and a third test dependent on your tribe (Preservation or Destruction).
{% endhint %}

**\[Test of Wisdom]**\
Talk to Zongkui in Jina Town to fetch Moriya's 20-question ordeal; wrong answers force you to kill 20 Ananga before retry. The answers are as follows:

&#x20;1\. Vartan\
2\. 10 People\
3\. Indra\
4\. Nagamudra Hima\
5\. 5050\
6\. Apvas\
7\. Exile Region\
8\. 1432 People\
9\. Ananga Dvanta\
10\. Amrita\
11\. 44%\
12\. Shambala\
13\. 8 Kings War\
14\. 15 Kinds\
15\. Haimayuga\
16\. Vananta\
17\. 6 Types\
18\. 8 Kings Castle\
19\. Chaturanga\
20\. 1/126&#x20;

:white\_check\_mark:Reward: Paper Piece

***

**\[Test of Justice]**\
Form a party in the Duel Arena and slay the Libertine for Huang Dao Pao.\
:white\_check\_mark:Reward: Friend's Name Cloth

***

**\[Test of Preservation]**\
Collect Moon Oxhorn, White Tiger Strap Leather, Lizard Boss Bow String Tendon, and Mangriang Glue Cell for Ouyez, then deliver 15 Hard Fabrics to Saranu.

:white\_check\_mark:Reward: Blood Cloth

***

**\[Test of Destruction]**\
Kill opposing God Scouts in your Fortress (per tribe) for Iddung Dashu, then return to Zangzu to complete your 2nd-job upgrade.

:white\_check\_mark:Reward: Destruction Proof Item

</details>

# Rare Armor Crafting

{% hint style="info" %}
Since the [latest patch](https://discord.com/channels/1363839027114934315/1392923460854091868), we can now craft **rare set armors**! These rare sets grant valuable stats, for example, the **Lv. 58 rare set** gives **damage absorption**. And the best part? **Crafting never fails!** That's right, 100% success, guaranteed!
{% endhint %}

Depending on the level of the rare set you're aiming for, speak to one of the following NPCs:

* Sacrificial Priest Saranu in Shambala – Rare Set Lv. 46,
* Armor Salesman Wangddaopo in Jina – Rare Set Lv. 58,
* Farmer Shunongs in Exile – Rare Set Lv. 64,

After hunting monsters and gathering raw materials, follow these three simple steps to craft a rare armor piece:

1. Process raw materials into usable materials,
2. Use those materials to form armor components,
3. Craft your final armor piece using those components

{% stepper %}
{% step %}

### Process the Raw Materials

Once you’ve collected raw materials from monsters, head to **Wangddaopo**, choose `Armor Crafting`, then select `Process Raw Materials`. Here, you’ll be able to process various types of materials. Each one requires specific raw drops from certain groups of monsters. The materials you can process include:

* **PL** – Processed Leather,
* **LS** – Thick Leather Strap,
* **ST** – Sacrificial Texture,
* **SS** – Sacrificial String,
* **GA** – Gluelike Agyo,
* **OG** – Ornaspirit Gongs,

Select any material to see which monster drops you need to gather. There are also **two special materials** obtained through quests only:

* **SI** – Strong Irons,
* **FH** – Feather of Holy Bird

{% hint style="info" %}
**Note the abbreviations**! These will be used later when forming armor components. Keep track of them!
{% endhint %}
{% endstep %}

{% step %}

### Form Armor Components

Now it’s time to form Armor Components using your processed materials. Each tribe prefers a specific type of component:

* **Satvan** – for Naga and Kimnara,
* **Dvanta** – for Asura and Rakshasa,
* **Nirvana** – for Yaksa and Gandharva,
* **Mantrika** – for Deva and Garuda

{% hint style="info" %}
Let’s say you’re crafting armor for **Banar** (a Naga), then you’ll be forming **Satvan components**. Return to **Wangddaopo**, go to `Armor Crafting`, then `Form Armor Components`. Choose Satvan from the options.
{% endhint %}

Each armor piece requires **four components**:

* **FR** – Frame
* **SP** – Sangpan (Outer Layer)
* **NP** – Nepi (Inner Layer)
* **AC** – Accessory

{% hint style="info" %}
For example, if you need **Satvan Pants Nepi**, select the option: `Satvan Pants NP: 2ST, 1SS` . This means you need:

* 2 × Sacrificial Texture (ST),
* 1 × Sacrificial String (SS)
  {% endhint %}

Once you form the **Nepi**, repeat the process for:

* Satvan Pants Frame,
* Satvan Pants Sangpan,
* Satvan Pants Accessory,

This completes all the components required for crafting rare Naga pants. Want rare gloves next? Then form:

* Satvan Gloves Frame,
* Satvan Gloves Sangpan,
* Satvan Gloves Nepi,
* Satvan Gloves Accessory
  {% endstep %}

{% step %}

### Craft the Armor Itself

You’ve made it! It’s time to use your components and **craft your final equipment**. Each piece requires a certain amount of:

* Frame (FR),
* Outer Layer – Sangpan (SP),
* Inner Layer – Nepi (NP),
* Accessory (AC),

Continuing with our example, you're crafting **Naga Pants**, and Naga uses Satvan Components. You’ll need the specific components for the piece:

* Satvan Pants Frame,
* Satvan Pants Sangpan,
* Satvan Pants Nepi,
* Satvan Pants Accessory,

To finish, go to `Armor Crafting`, then `Craft Final Equipment`. Choose the option for **Armor for Naga and Kimnara**. You’ll see something like: `Pants: 5FR, 5SP, 5NP, 5AC`. This means you need:

* 5 Frames,
* 5 Sangpans,
* 5 Nepis,
* 5 Accessories,
* 5,000,000 Rupiah,

Once you’ve gathered everything and clicked on it… BOOM! You’ve crafted the **Sumatri Amsatra Pants of Grapa**!

{% hint style="info" %}

### Final Notes

Each level of rare set requires a different amount of **Rupiah** and **components** to craft:

* **Shambala** (Lv. 46): 3,000,000 Rupiah and **2 of each component**,
* **Jina** (Lv. 58): 5,000,000 Rupiah and **5 of each component**,
* **Exile** (Lv. 64): 8,000,000 Rupiah and **10 of each component**,

Sure, it’s a bit of a journey—but where’s the fun in getting everything too easily? And don’t forget: **the success rate is 100%!**
{% endhint %}
{% endstep %}
{% endstepper %}
